prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign changes (only 1 test conducted so far).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in hint changes (only 1 test conducted so far).
Evidence is still thin for home wait_info changes (only 1 test conducted so far).
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +4.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Overview Screen: Insert a dedicated information screen right before home_intro that outlines desktop controls like dragging, right-click menus, and hiding the pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets, while finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Recovery Hint: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen urging returning users to use their existing credentials to prevent losing existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Readiness Alert: Add system notification option and display hint to the waiting screen so users know how to locate their pet if it spawns off-screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or app not opening during initial render.)
3: [adoption, layout] Two Column Photo Upload Guidelines: Change upload_photos screen to a two-column layout with photo quality guidelines and bad example illustrations. (why: 3 support tickets cited custom pet creation failure or distorted pet generation.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Welcome Copy Update: Update home_intro headline, body, and button label to clearly signal pet activation and immediate desktop interaction. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and overall onboarding conversion is 18.7%; clear call-to-action improves final step completion.)
